objective.name: sandbox.dsl.branch.remote.meaning
objective.description: Branch on a meaning-derived value obtained from a remote wrapper-backed reflective capacity and choose a local or remote wrapper terminal call.

#root.role: Invoke one remote wrapper-backed reflective capacity, branch on the returned meaning-derived objective name, and choose a wrapper-backed terminal route.

effects.remote_reflective_wrapper_route: A remote wrapper-backed reflective route crosses the inter-instance boundary.
effects.branch_terminal_route: The terminal route invokes either a remote or a local wrapper-backed capacity.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one branch-specific terminal response selected from a meaning-derived value returned by a remote wrapper-backed reflective capacity.
invariants: The branch decision is taken from remote_meaning.payload.objective_name returned by the remote wrapper-backed reflective helper.
The flow chooses between a remote and a local sandbox.echo terminal route, but the N7 fixture is arranged so the remote route is selected.
success: The terminal payload exposes echo and ctx_id from the selected sandbox.echo branch.
When objective_name equals sandbox.echo, the terminal payload comes from the remote beta-child wrapper.
failure: The flow fails if the remote reflective helper cannot return the meaning-derived objective name.
The flow fails if the selected wrapper-backed terminal route cannot complete across its local or remote boundary.
notes: This scenario validates branching on a value that was itself derived by a wrapper through reflexive access.
The terminal branch payload shape follows sandbox.echo, not a custom DSL-specific envelope.
